purpose: verified-pilot-3.20: original-paper links for species that already have Wikidata P703 statements (team-lead decision 2026-10-02).
rule: A paper link for a species with P703 statements is admitted only when the paper names the species (WoRMS accepted name or a WoRMS synonym) and states where its sample came from; the other paper-link conditions of 3.1 (single defined compound, isolated or identified from the species, InChIKey equal to the PubChem record) still apply, and every link carries a link-review decision.

europepmc_fulltext_p703.title: Open-access full texts read for the 3.20 paper links (PMC8794173, PMC9858231)
europepmc_fulltext_p703.version: fullTextXML of PMC8794173 (PLoS ONE 17:e0258980, 2022) and PMC9858231 (Foods 12:244, 2023), read 2026-10-02

held.reason: Held by the team lead (2026-10-02): its highest ChEMBL values are PubChem qHTS rows marked Inconclusive (PGA2 influenza NS1, 15-keto-PGE2 ROR-gamma); without them only a qHTS 'Active' screening hit or a weak Nur77 Kd would carry the species score.

verification.species_as_published: Laminaria japonica (WoRMS synonym of Saccharina japonica, 377084)
verification.sample_origin: Cultivated at Yantai, Shandong, China (cultivar GS-02-004-2013), harvested July 2018, sun-dried then oven-dried at 50 C (Section 2.2)
verification.reason: Abstract and Section 3.1 name 24-hydroperoxy-24-vinyl-cholesterol among the five sterols isolated from this sample. The published 13C shifts suggest the paper swapped the labels of compounds 2 and 5 (C-24 at 89.1 ppm belongs to the hydroperoxide, 77.7 to saringosterol); both structures are among the isolates either way, so the link holds, but the masses per compound are uncertain.

review.reason: Isolated from cultivated Saccharina japonica (10.1371/journal.pone.0258980). Same autoxidation caveat as the 톳 link: the sample was sun- and oven-dried, and this hydroperoxide can form from fucosterol by photo-oxidation, so it may be a drying product rather than a biosynthetic one.

verification.sample_origin: Cultivated at Yantai, Shandong, China (cultivar GS-02-004-2013), harvested July 2018, sun-dried then oven-dried at 50 C (Section 2.2)
verification.reason: Abstract and Section 3.1 name saringosterol (24-vinyl-cholest-5-ene-3b,24-diol) among the five sterols isolated from this sample. PubChem resolves 'saringosterol' to the single CID 14161394 with this InChIKey.

review.reason: Isolated from Saccharina japonica (10.1371/journal.pone.0258980) and quantified by 1H NMR against a reference standard in Japanese kombu (10.3390/foods12020244). Same autoxidation caveat as the 톳 link.

verification.sample_origin: Collected in Japan, March to April 2021, 8 batches; production areas in the paper's Table S1 (Section 2.2)
verification.reason: Section 3.5 and Figure 6: saringosterol quantified by 1H NMR against a Sigma-Aldrich standard in every kombu batch (identified, not isolated).
